description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (RN) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned nursing leader to make a significant impact within a compassionate and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing role.
Proven leadership and management abilities within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, compensation based on experience.
